comments.text: You said the bees will die?  That is the cycle of life. A bee's life is about 65 days in the spring/summer. Brood phase (egg, larvae, pupae) is 21 day, as nurse bees working in the hive is 21 days , remainder day foraging for nectar and pollen. Each Bee will make 1/12 a teaspoon of honey in their life. Queen lays 1500-2000 eggs a day (about 1 egg every 10 seconds). Being social insects, they will die sooner without the colony from predictors, the elements, and loneliness. The colonies that survives will make hives anywhere they can. watch out for bees in the walls. Honey is acidic. Dead bees smell just like any other dead animal/insect and attract other animals and insects if the hive dies. Get them out if the move in (by a pro). Do not spray them with poison.
